description: Bihar cabinet approves ₹15,967 crore road plan, AI Mission, 400 electric buses and key reforms to boost infrastructure and growth
body_lead: Patna: The Bihar government has approved a series of major development decisions aimed at accelerating growth across infrastructure, industry, transport, education, health and digital governance. In a high-level cabinet meeting chaired by the Chief Minister, around 20 key proposals were cleared to strengthen the state’s overall development roadmap. Industrial Investment Policy Extended to Boost Growth The cabinet approved an extension of the Industrial Investment Promotion Package till June 30, 2026.
